freeze_timing: Before any C39 pipeline-quality metrics or C13 reserved labels are read.
comparison_kind: Two controlled exploratory scoring trials, not a claimed validated public improvement.
candidate_lists: Real complete reference-masked P01/C41 output lists for development. No truth insertion, forced candidates or absent-truth filtering.

serving.head_ranks: Stable score ranks within each same-formula tail group; the original rank1 is excluded from any permutation.
serving.support: At least one supported positive DreaMS acquisition per query. Entire formula group must have valid untruncated MoLFormer candidates; unsupported groups/queries retain parent order.

new_fitted_component_boundary: Must pass original-row identity/quarantine audit as well as chemistry-group exclusions; refit if additional contaminated fitting identities are found before outcomes.

admission.qualification_tier: Engineering-passed exploratory trials if all directional/source gates pass. Local calibration and public pretraining exposure remain disclosed; actual public scores decide improvement.

C13: Do not open for candidate or weight search. If both fixed recipes pass earlier checks, freeze a single paired evaluation protocol before one joint reserved-label access. Report both results and their uncertainty; do not revise either recipe using reserved outcomes.
submission_sequence: At most two new accepted scoring entries. Real changed-path Kaggle smoke and independent source/artifact checks precede each entry; observe the first actual terminal result before releasing the second.
